title: UsableInvoices
description: Which invoices count as income in which month, overriding the default. The default rule is: an invoice is usable in the month after it fell due. Only entries the owner wrote down live here — an invoice not listed follows the default, and this file staying empty is the ordinary case. An override cannot put income before the invoice was due: its month must not precede the due month.

month.description: The month this invoice counts as income, YYYY-MM. Must not precede the invoice's due month.
